generation.mode: built-in imagegen edit with the edit target first and the canon second as reference only

lighting_isotropy.metric: 36-bin land-luminance-gradient magnitude peak divided by uniform-bin mean; water-mask pixels excluded and gradients below 12 luminance units excluded
lighting_isotropy.visual_check: No whole-cell cast-shadow field or sun angle is obvious, but many boulders have bright upper planes and dark side faces, and conifer crowns retain directional value separation. The literal same-value-all-round rule is not met.

median_conifer_crown_final_scale.measurement: Median connected dark-green crown-core width across 57 isolated or partially merged candidate conifer components, scaled by 2560/1254; diagnostic overlay is c0-0-conifer-components.png. The threshold can omit lighter branch tips, but many complete visible crowns remain below the required source-scale floor.

buildable_vs_steep_fraction.basis: manual estimated fraction of non-water land area
buildable_vs_steep_fraction.method: The open moor, south shelf glades, and sheltered grassy hollow count as buildable; only the narrow beck banks count as steep; dense conifer groups, boulder fields, outcrops, and scrub make up the remainder.

water_mask.encoding: opaque white water pixels on fully transparent non-water pixels; binary alpha
water_mask.derivation: Source-raster colour classification constrained to broad painted-water search corridors, followed by local closure, small-component filtering, and enclosed-hole filling. The final boundary follows painted wet pixels rather than a supplied polyline.
water_mask.component_note: The main beck is intermittently occluded by channel rocks; small disconnected mask components retain visible wet highlights. The separate south-bleed pool is another component.

final_canvas_gate_reproduction.note: The installed Node executable was unavailable in the managed shell, so the repository-style source-radius proxy was reproduced locally with System.Drawing.

claims: The written cell brief says nothing wet arrives at the south edge and no water may touch any edge.
The mandatory edit target visibly contains painted turquoise water touching its south edge, while the mandatory edit preamble says that painted terrain stays exactly where it is.
authority_conflict.measured_input_evidence: The edit-target bottom row contains 189 strong water-colour pixels from x=1114 through x=1322 under the same local classifier used for the source check.
authority_conflict.ruling: The one-call raw edit preserved the supplied painted context; no post-generation repaint was made because that would violate the raw-output and one-edit-call contract. The resulting south-edge water is reported as a hard cell-brief failure rather than silently omitted from the mask.

open_risks: Hard edge-water failure: the delivered raw source includes a separate painted pool touching the south edge; the mask correctly includes 73 south-edge water pixels.
Hard scale failure: the measured median crown core is 44.912 px / 2.156 m at final scale, below the required 84-147 px / 4-7 m range; many visible crowns are smaller still.
Hard lighting and rock-value failure: boulders visibly retain bright upper planes and dark side faces despite the low aggregate directional-key first moment.
Several conifers read as isolated open-moor trees rather than being confined strictly to gullies and hollows.
The 6 px and 48 px mask-ring proxies pass, but the official Node authoring gate was unavailable in this managed shell.
Seam continuity, water-mask judgment, and overall visual quality remain director and owner decisions; this report does not claim visual acceptance.
